capabilities: Visualize tasks and their relations in an auto-laid-out flow graph
Track task status on a drag-and-drop kanban board with a project filter
List a project's tasks by status in a side panel with quick task creation
Scaffold project, task, and reference notes with frontmatter via commands
Create Tasks.base and References.base views for project notes
extras: Release assets carry GitHub build provenance attestations; the plugin makes no network requests and requires Obsidian 1.13.0+.
motivation: The frontmatter fields and folder conventions are opinionated, built around how the author personally organizes their own vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to manage projects and tasks as linked notes with status tracking, relations, and board or graph views.

relations.evidence: Works alongside the core Bases plugin: project notes embed Tasks.base and References.base views
Recommended: the community plugin Base Board, which the generated Tasks.base views use

summary: Project and task management plugin with a task flow graph, kanban board, project side panel, and commands that scaffold linked notes via frontmatter.
